linhas.en:
Meltlilith's second SG.

Doll maniacs, enthusiasts and such have different tastes.
Some collect them as antiques or works of art,
some use them as interior decoration.
And some seem to have it the other way around,
for whatever reason, loving#RUBS people who are like dolls#RUBE doll-like people#REND.

Meltlilith's Doll Mania covers all of these.
She obsessively collects dolls, displays, loves,
and tramples them. It's a love that's only one-way.

"I don't need anything but myself.
 I don't even need the heart of the one I love―――"

That's how Meltlilith lives her life.
She wants "#RUBSsomething#RUBEa lover#REND to pour her love into, nothing more."
She may not even acknowledge the other person's
sentience or freedom at all.

             ◆

What is a doll, in the first place?
A substitute modeled after a human being,
or a product intended to be an ideal human?
To the perfectionist Meltlilith, an SG like "Doll Mania"
may be her own brand of romanticism.

In addition, she seems to have a special fondness
for "small things". Taking things that catch her interest,
abusing them, shrinking them down, and collecting them
are one of the few hobbies Meltlilith has.
A doll house might not sound so bad,
but all you'll find there is a cage of despair.
There are times a young girl's innocence leads to cruelty.
